description.title: Delivered within a 50% shortened web-development schedule by proposing an FE-led response plan to PMs and designers and adapting implementation throughout the project
Introduced a BFF layer with Next.js Route Handlers, centralising shared API integration and response-code handling in the frontend server
p: reduced maintenance costs for API specification changes and validation while simplifying connections to event APIs

description.title: Resolved network load from multiple videos, including a 200MB asset, by validating CDN delivery types and introducing HLS streaming on mobile
p: reduced video delay from 10 seconds to 3 seconds

description.title: Applied Mobile First sizing to UI components and CSS max() to image assets according to their purpose
p: preserved design intent without layout breakage across screen sizes

selectedProject.title: Shared Frontend Development Environment

description.title: Replaced separate Webpack + JavaScript setups with a shared React + Vite development environment
Systematised recurring work through event templates, a development CLI, and shared components
p: reduced project setup time by 85%, from roughly one hour to under ten minutes

description.title: Connected deployment pipelines spread across five channels to the development environment
p: reduced deployment time by about 80%, from over 30 minutes to under five minutes

description.title: Added an optional build-time image compression process that removes duplicate pixels
p: reduced resource size by up to 80% while preventing unnecessary quality loss

description.title: Standardised a custom image-load detection hook
Documented project conventions for a Claude-assisted development environment
p: improved consistency while preserving developer autonomy

selectedProject.title: Operations Workflow Automation

description.title: Proposed and developed a content-generation tool to remove bottlenecks from repetitive live-operations work
Identified the design rules required for implementation, presented them to designers, and refined the rules collaboratively
Integrated the Figma API to scan components and layers created under the agreed design rules and automatically generate HTML content
Built a single tool to scan and classify source files, create content URLs, deploy by rule, and share Jira tickets across the complete workflow
Reduced operations turnaround time by approximately 92%, from an average of one hour per task to under five minutes

selectedProject.stack: React · TypeScript · Vite · GSAP · Claude Code · Figma API · Jira Ticket

description.title: Needed to deliver multiple high-resolution alpha-channel videos, but APNG caused heavy page loads while Canvas chroma keying created frame-by-frame thread overhead
Evaluated APNG, Canvas chroma keying, Lottie, WebM Alpha, and HEVC Alpha, then designed a browser-specific dual-format HEVC/WebM strategy
p: reduced resource size by 70% compared with APNG while maintaining cross-browser support

description.title: Implemented semantic markup, descriptive image alt text, and SEO-oriented event summaries
p: improved search visibility and screen-reader support

description.title: Proposed keyboard-based page navigation in addition to mouse interaction

21st Anniversary Illustration Gallery

description.title: Designed and built the complete Three.js 3D web gallery and its GSAP-powered scroll interactions
The initial implementation recalculated gallery rotation and position on every scroll event, causing excessive computation
p: applied throttling to suppress redundant consecutive calculations and stabilise scroll handling

description.title: Replaced 162 individually rendered Plane meshes with InstancedMesh
p: reduced draw calls from 162 to 1 and improved frame stability

about.name: Hello, I'm Chaewon!
about.intro: Frontend developer crafting both sides of the screen — interactions users see, and environments developers feel. Having studied both design and engineering, I care about craft on screen and the systems behind it. I'm drawn to building not just polished interfaces, but better ways to build them: structure, automation, and the kind of tooling that makes a team's day-to-day a little less painful.
